messages:
ashley: Heads up — saw a big p99/compile spike on main after the merge at ~08:12 UTC. CI perf job flagged it. Anyone else?
ci-bot: perf-ci: regression detected in 'inference-runtime-latency' suite. p99 up 350ms -> 1.8s, compile_time increase +12x. Details: https://ci.redwood/internal/perf/1234
leo: yikes. stacktrace shows a lot of kernel compilations on warm requests, and kv_cache evictions spiking.
maya: I pulled a flamegraph. looks like pick_kernel_variant() now favours 'fp16_fast' for seq>1024; that triggers heavier compile path due to missing cached kernels for that seq length.
sam: Can you paste the logs? also did we change autotune scoring last week? PR #3490 touched heuristic weightings.
ashley: (typo, meant ashley)
ashley: ```
[2026-03-17T08:10:33Z] compile start kernel=attn_fused seq=1536 variant=fp16_fast
[2026-03-17T08:10:34Z] compile_time=1.82s cache_hit=false
[2026-03-17T08:10:35Z] kv_cache.evictions=420 per_min
```
leo: Those compile_time numbers match the spike. Before patch same kernel used variant 'fallback_fp32' compiled earlier, compile_time ~0.11s.
maya: Interesting: the autoregister key includes seq_buckets and some quant flag. I suspect the cache key normalization changed in 0xabcde7 — bucketization moved from 256 to 512 granularity -> cache fragmentation.
sam: Can we bisect? I can run quick local bisect with the perf harness.
build-bot: build-bot: Started perf-bisect job: bisect range main~20..main. Logging results to https://ci.redwood/internal/bisect/789
ashley: We should hold the rollout for the canary that hit this. I've paused canary in us-west-2. @ops please stop canary traffic.
ops: Stopping canary now. :white_check_mark:
leo: tmp mitigation: flip runtime flag `prefer_cached_variant=true` which forces using existing cache entries even if score slightly worse.
maya: That will avoid compilation flood but may regress latency in some tail cases. Still acceptable for rollback window.
sam: Bisect found culprit: commit 0xabcde7 (PR #3490) — changed score normalization. Reverting locally clears spike. I'll propose hotfix PR to revert that change and add tests for cache key invariants.
ashley: (again typo)
ashley: Please push revert and mark for emergency deploy. Also add e2e that simulates seq distribution with 512/1024/1536.
sam: On it. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3501 (revert).
maya: Also let's add metric `kernel_cache_buckets` and alert on >100 delta/min.
leo: :thumbsup: good call. I'll add dashboard panels.
build-bot: perf-ci: revert PR #3501 perf job passed on canary. p99 back to baseline. Closing incident?
ashley: (typo)
ashley: Thanks everyone. We'll keep canary paused until hotfix is deployed across regions.
